# HexPiece 2.2.7

Gryphon and Yoru, from the models you sent. Nothing here has been tested in game yet; the build's checks and tests pass, and the
blades, their draws and the ropes were rendered from the game's own rig and judged (`docs/images/yoru-draw.png`,
`docs/images/yoru-sheathe-charge.png`, `docs/images/gryphon-hip.png`, `docs/images/legend-icons.png`).

## The two strongest blades
- **Gryphon**: the saber, Supreme Grade, edge x1.55 (every katana is x1.36 at most). Worn where the katanas are, in its blue-lacquered
  scabbard at the left hip, its gold bell guard and knucklebow in front. Held and swung exactly like a katana.
- **Yoru**: the black blade, Supreme Grade, edge x1.75 (the strongest), and it reaches about a block further than any other blade.
  Held and swung exactly like a katana (so in the low guard its point dips into the ground: it's longer than the katana poses are).
- **Yoru never turns black** with Armament or Ryou on (it is black already), but the Haki lightning still crackles round it.
- **Both are drawn the moment you turn combat mode on**, stay out the whole fight (no sheathing when idle), and only go back when you
  turn combat mode off or switch to your fruit.
- Neither is ever carried by a pirate patrol. Both are at the end of the Katanas creative tab (and `/give`: `hexhaki:katana_gryphon`,
  `hexhaki:katana_yoru`).

## Yoru on your back
- **Huge**: 2.75 blocks from pommel to point, half as tall again as you (you said "Yoru IS way bigger than that" about the first try,
  which was only as tall as a player). Its cross guard is wider than your shoulders.
- Tied on with two hemp ropes: one from over your left shoulder across your chest to your right hip and back up across your back,
  one round your waist, both pulled tight over the blade where they cross it.
- Slung across your back, not straight up like in your Mihawk picture: at this size, upright it would go through the ground or through
  your head, and its grip would be out of a Minecraft arm's reach. I had the computer search every placement for the biggest Yoru that
  fits: the hilt rises above your head over your right shoulder, the cross guard sits behind that shoulder, and the blade runs down
  across your back past your left leg to just above the ground, standing a little off your back (the head is in the way higher up).
- **Its own draw**, after your unsheath clip: your right hand reaches up behind your head to the hilt over your shoulder, lifts it out of
  the ropes, sweeps it up over your head and down, and holds it low at your right hip, angled up across the front, before settling into
  the guard. The sheathe is the same in reverse; a charge from the back rips it off your shoulder straight into the charge.
- With Yoru on your back there's no hilt at your hip, so the idle stance keeps both arms loose.

## Unchanged
The network protocol is the same as 2.2.1 (the two new blades go at the end of the list: saved katanas stay as they were).
